a: KPIs are key performance indicators used to track goals.
Revenue is income from selling goods or services.
Margin is profit as a share of revenue.
Profit is accounting; cash is actual money movement.
Unit economics studies profit per customer or unit sold.
Churn is the rate at which customers leave.
LTV estimates total value of a customer over the relationship.
CAC is the cost to acquire a customer.
Runway is how long cash lasts at the current burn rate.
A pivot is a significant change in product or business model.
